title.zh: 所得税（外国收入豁免）（第 2 号）命令 2001
title.en: Income Tax (Exemption of Foreign Income) (No. 2) Order 2001

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Income Tax (Exemption of Foreign Income) (No. 2) Order 2001.

2. Onyx Asia Holdings Pte Ltd is hereby granted exemption from tax on the foreign dividends it receives in Singapore from approved investments in a country outside Singapore, subject to the terms and conditions specified in the letter of approval dated 2nd August 2001 addressed to the company.
